text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while passing by the training 
track...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Please, um... forget what just happened. 
I'm sure I wasn't very good at it anyway.
choice_data_list: I thought you did well, though.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the notes might have been right, 
but... hitting the right pitch and 
actually singing well are two different 
things.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My grandmother always used to say: 'A live 
performance is an occasion for gratitude.'

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even if you think you sang well, it's 
meaningless without heart.
choice_data_list:
So you're quite strict when it comes to 
singing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I think that's just how much they 
loved it. The Twinkle Series, that is.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
According to what my mother told me, my 
grandmother was apparently one of the 
members who worked tirelessly when the 
Grand Live was first founded.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Apparently so. When I first started 
learning about the Grand Live, I found out 
and was totally shocked.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I really wish I could have 
introduced my grandma to Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, oops, I'm sorry! I ended up talking 
only about myself."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... listening to you sing up until now, 
I've always thought you were really good, 
<chrname>-san.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"So when she stands on the live stage, 
please make sure to keep your eyes on 
her."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm sure that song is filled with 
gratitude for the fans, and for the person 
who supported her closest of all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I had the opportunity to 
observe <chrname>'s dance lesson.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It truly felt as though her feelings were 
poured into her song.
